x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
F1 races at Madring for the FIRST TIME this weekend.

5.47km. 22 turns. The longest banked corner in modern F1. 340 kph straight.

No team has ever run a lap here in anger. Nobody has a setup baseline.

That changes Friday. #F1 #MadridGP

x_posts.text:
5 questions for the Madrid Grand Prix:

1. Does the blank-slate circuit reset the Antonelli run?
2. Can Leclerc bounce back from Monza?
3. Ferrari vs. Mercedes in the Constructors'?
4. Who finds setup first?
5. Is the banked corner chaos?

Friday tells us everything. #F1
